text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, today is the day Maruzensky
makes her
debut!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I'm getting kind of nervous now
that the
day has finally arrived...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why are you making that face?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why are you making that face?
choice_data_list: 抜かりは無いか、気になって……
choice_data_list_en: I was just worried if anything slipped through the cracks...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's fine! You did a primo job training me!
choice_data_list: 抜かりは無いか、気になって……
choice_data_list_en: I was just worried if anything slipped through the cracks...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the journey is more important
than the
destination. I'm going to have a
great time, so
don't you worry!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
choice_data_list_en: Go out there and run your heart out!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's the Twinkle Series, you know, so I'm
going full
throttle!
